description: List a wallet's staking, liquid staking and lending positions (native stakes, afSUI, haSUI, vSUI, sSUI, stSUI, Suilend, NAVI, Scallop), each with an id and the step that exits it, and with exit build the exit transactions: unsigned, gassed and checked on current mainnet state, or the reason one would fail. to swaps the proceeds into one coin in the same transaction. Example: { wallet: "0x...", exit: "all", to: "USDC" }.

exit.description: Position ids to build exits for, or "all". Left out: only the list.

to.description: Swap each exit's proceeds into this coin.

wallet.description: The wallet that holds the positions and will sign (0x address).

name: withdraw_plan
title: Exit a wallet's positions
